items.t: Announced the launch of the new Tennessee Businesses Against Trafficking program through the Department of State.
items.q: Tennessee Secretary of State Tre Hargett today joined with General Assembly members and community advocates to announce the launch of the new Tennessee Businesses Against Trafficking program through the Department of State.

items.t: Encouraged eligible Tennesseans to register to vote as part of National Voter Registration Day.
items.q: Secretary of State Tre Hargett Encourages Eligible Tennesseans to Register to Vote as Part of National Voter Registration Day

record.t: Announced a statewide partnership with the Department of Health and the Department of Safety and Homeland Security to distribute free Baby in the Back hangtags to help prevent heat-related child deaths in cars.
record.q: Secretary of State Tre Hargett, the Department of Health and the Department of Safety and Homeland Security announced a statewide partnership to distribute free Baby in the Back hangtags to help prevent heat-related child deaths in cars.

record.t: Was elected by the Tennessee General Assembly as Tennessee's 37th secretary of state in 2009 and re-elected in 2013, 2017, 2021 and 2025.
record.q: Tre Hargett was elected by the Tennessee General Assembly to serve as Tennessee’s 37th secretary of state in 2009 and re-elected in 2013, 2017, 2021, and 2025.

record.t: Served in the Tennessee House of Representatives for a decade representing District 97 and was twice elected Republican Leader by his colleagues.
record.q: Secretary Hargett served in the Tennessee House of Representatives for a decade representing District 97 (Bartlett and Memphis) and was twice elected Republican Leader by his colleagues.

record.t: Oversaw the Tennessee Regulatory Authority after a decade in the General Assembly.
record.q: Hargett served a decade in the General Assembly before overseeing the Tennessee Regulatory Authority.

record.t: Serves on 16 boards and commissions, and is the presiding member of two of them.
record.q: He also serves on 16 boards and commissions, on two of which he is the presiding member.

record.t: Serves as chairman of the executive committee of the Republican Secretaries of State Committee.
record.q: as well as chairman of the executive committee of the Republican Secretaries of State Committee (RSSC)

record.t: Leads a department that offers online voter registration and the GoVoteTN mobile app.
record.q: The department offers Tennesseans online voter registration and the GoVoteTN mobile app to help increase voter registration, turnout and awareness.

record.t: Encouraged victims of human trafficking, stalking, domestic abuse or sexual offenses to protect their addresses under a free state program.
record.q: The Tennessee secretary of state is encouraging victims of human trafficking, stalking, domestic abuse or any sexual offense to protect their addresses from public disclosure under a free state program.

record.t: Announced a hotline and a voter fraud text reporting system for the November 3 election.
record.q: Tennessee Secretary of State Offers Hotline and Voter Fraud Text Reporting System for November 3 Election
